description: Visa establishes SBC identity, Brale issuer role, U.S.-dollar backing and Canton support, but original launch date, reserve composition, assurance reporting, holder claim, direct redemption terms and control roles are not established here.
notes: Do not infer reserve or redemption mechanics from the proof-of-concept announcement.

description: Circle establishes Movement deployment, 1:1 USDC backing, xReserve mechanics and the mainnet token address, but the complete governance, attester, pause, upgrade and interface-specific eligibility/control map is not normalized here.
notes: Movement is not treated as a conventional legal issuer; protocol control roles remain separately unresolved.

description: Universal establishes issuer identity, regulatory scope, safeguarded 1:1 USD reserves and monthly independent attestation, but complete attestation history, redemption fees/timing/minimums, deployment inventory and insolvency treatment are not established here.
notes: Do not infer bankruptcy remoteness or unrestricted retail redemption.

description: Stably establishes August 2025 Ethereum launch, Brale issuance, 1:1 cash-and-cash-equivalent backing and verified-user redemption, but exact launch day, token contract, recurring reserve-assurance history and current administrative controls are not established here.
notes: Month-level launch evidence is not converted into a guessed day.

description: MetaMask establishes mUSD identity, Bridge issuance, M0 infrastructure, 1:1 short-term Treasury backing and Ethereum/Linea availability, but complete direct issuer-redemption terms, Linea contract identity, reserve custody details and current control roles are not established here.
notes: Separate MetaMask rewards and Money Account yield are not treated as intrinsic mUSD yield.
